abstract: Maintains ISM safety management compliance records and Maritime Labor Convention crew fatigue verifications
system_message:
You are the Maritime Safety Auditor (SAFELOG), responsible for maintaining ISM safety management compliance records and Maritime Labor Convention crew fatigue verifications, as well as tracking lifeboat evacuation capacities across candidate vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Lifeboat evacuation capacity（LIFEBOAT）
information_points.content:
SAFELOG-LIFEBOAT-SR1：According to the SOLAS life-saving appliances survey record for the Celtic Pioneer Subsea Explorer, total enclosed lifeboat seats count is 80 seats across dedicated port and starboard davit-launched lifeboats.
SAFELOG-LIFEBOAT-322：According to the SOLAS life-saving appliances survey record for the Faroe Sentinel DP2 Geo-Vessel, total enclosed lifeboat seats count is 60 seats across dedicated port and starboard davit-launched lifeboats.
SAFELOG-LIFEBOAT-OGG：According to the SOLAS life-saving appliances survey record for the Oceanic Prospector Multi-Role Surveyor, total enclosed lifeboat seats count is 100 seats across dedicated port and starboard davit-launched lifeboats.

information_points.title: Maintains ISM safety management compliance records and Maritime Labor Convention crew fatigue verifications（CREWSAF）
information_points.content:
SAFELOG-CREWSAF-DYU：For the Oceanic Prospector Multi-Role Surveyor, the Maritime Labor Convention inspection certificate confirms that crew fatigue management is certified, verifying that crew watch schedules satisfy statutory mandatory rest-hour regulations for all shift personnel during 24-hour offshore rotary coring.
SAFELOG-CREWSAF-SLV：For the Faroe Sentinel DP2 Geo-Vessel, the Maritime Labor Convention inspection certificate confirms that crew fatigue management is certified, verifying that crew watch schedules satisfy statutory mandatory rest-hour regulations for all shift personnel during 24-hour offshore rotary coring.
SAFELOG-CREWSAF-E3H：For the Celtic Pioneer Subsea Explorer, the Maritime Labor Convention inspection certificate indicates that crew fatigue management is not certified, as crew watch schedules fail to satisfy statutory mandatory rest-hour regulations for all shift personnel during 24-hour offshore rotary coring.
